about_the_game:
Looking for a unique dungeon crawler exploration game? You are in the right place.

Embark on an epic journey with "Seeker of the Ruins," a captivating exploration adventure set in the forgotten depths of ancient dwarven ruins. As a courageous dwarf delver, your mission is to uncover long-lost treasures, unravel hidden secrets, and navigate the dangerous paths of the ancient realm.

Key Features:

Exploration: Venture your way through various epic ancient dwarven ruins. Find your way through the remains while collecting treasure and uncovering hidden secrets.

Hidden Areas: Discover secret rooms and concealed passages tucked away behind false walls and cryptic symbols. These hidden areas offer rare treasures, and shortcuts to the deeper mysteries of the ruins.

No-Combat Gameplay: Experience danger through clever traps, environmental hazards, and ancient mechanisms that challenge your wits rather than your weapons. Outsmart the perils of the depths and navigate safely through the labyrinth.

Sneak Mechanics: Slip silently past dangers by mastering stealth and timing. Avoid detection as you traverse shadowy corridors and bypass looming traps, ensuring your exploration remains uninterrupted and your path remains secret.

Using Items to Your Advantage: Harness a variety of unique gadgets and mystical potions to bypass obstacles. Experiment by combining items to disarm traps, reveal hidden inscriptions, or get past enemies.

Puzzles: Navigate through environments filled with clues embedded in the surroundings. From deciphering runes etched into cavern walls to interpreting the layout of a dwarven forge, to unlock forgotten chambers and treasure caches.


Are you ready to delve into the depths and reclaim the forgotten legacy of the dwarves?

short_description: As a fearless dwarf delver, explore ancient ruins, uncover hidden treasures, and solve riddles. Use items and potions to succeed and outsmart monsters & environmental hazards in this immersive non-combat adventure. Venture into the deeps in seek of luck and fortune. Will you succeed?
